vo01_problem.speaker: advait
vo01_problem.text: Every day, lenders send the same reminder to every borrower.

vo02_pain.speaker: advait
vo02_pain.text: It's expensive. It's annoying. And it gets ignored.

vo04_decides.speaker: advait
vo04_decides.text: It decides, for each person, each day, whether to reach out, or wait.

vo05_channels.speaker: advait
vo05_channels.text: SMS. WhatsApp. Voice. Or a human.

vo06_aladdin.speaker: advait
vo06_aladdin.text: Every decision is checked by Aladdin. Twice.

vo07_stop.speaker: advait
vo07_stop.text: Say stop, and it stops. Everywhere.

vo09_learns.speaker: advait
vo09_learns.text: And it learns, live, from every reply.

vo10_proof.speaker: advait
vo10_proof.text: Twice the money recovered for every rupee spent. Zero rule breaches.

vo11_end.speaker: advait
vo11_end.text: Kairos. The right message, at the right time. Or none at all.

agent01_hi.speaker: ritu
agent01_hi.text: नमस्ते! आपकी EMI की तारीख कल है। क्या मैं आपको पेमेंट लिंक भेज दूँ?

agent02_en.speaker: ritu
agent02_en.text: Sure, sending your payment link on WhatsApp right now.
